prompt: What is the man's best choice if he wants to go on Friday and make sure his mother can read the captions?
promptZh: 如果男子希望星期五看電影，又要讓媽媽看得清字幕，他最適合選哪種安排？

options.text: The early show in the front row
options.whyZh: 早場有大銀幕字幕，但前排座位已售完。

options.text: The early show in the closer side seats
options.zh: 早場較靠近銀幕的側邊座位
options.whyZh: 較近不代表更容易看字幕；喇叭支架會遮住銀幕底部。

options.text: The late show with a seat in the middle
options.whyZh: 中間區的視野不能彌補晚場字幕不在大銀幕、裝置又借不到的問題。

options.text: The early show in the middle section
options.whyZh: 早場大銀幕有字幕；中間區確定看得清楚，且前排已售罄、側邊視線會受阻。

explanationZh: 早場大銀幕有字幕；中間區確定看得清楚，且前排已售罄、側邊視線會受阻。
evidence: Friday's early show has captions on the main screen. | The seats at the front are sold out | Try the middle section. We checked the captions from there yesterday. The side seats are closer, but the speaker stands block the bottom of the screen. | The late show offers captions only on a device you borrow. Those devices are all reserved.

vocabulary.term: block the bottom of the screen
vocabulary.note: block 是遮住視線；座位較近不一定看得更清楚。
